Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Lord Shiva / Narayan confluence lore blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
